info.title: CF Meet public API Gateway
info.description: Customer ingress of services/api-gateway (Part VI §§1–5 foundation). Default deny: only routes in the gateway's compiled route catalogue are served and only when API_GATEWAY_PUBLIC_ROUTING_ENABLED is true; every other path is NOT_FOUND. Internal (/internal/**), provider-callback, operator-administration and Telephony surfaces are never routable. Credentials are verified by Platform Access only; tenant / application / environment come from its authority chain, never from the request. Upstreams receive a short-lived signed service token carrying the delegated platform context and keep final resource authorization. The Section 51 route catalogue is not part of this version.

get.description: Foundation route (catalogue id developer-platform.context): authenticates the credential through Platform Access and forwards to the Developer Platform (GET /internal/v1/gateway/context) with the signed delegated context. Served only when API_GATEWAY_PUBLIC_ROUTING_ENABLED is true.

200.description: Canonical context of the credential's application environment.

platformCredential.description: A CF Meet API credential issued by Platform Access (Authorization: Bearer). X-CF-* headers supplied by a client are stripped; a client X-CF-Service-Authorization is refused.
